ordering at a café or restaurant.text: Je voudrais un café et un croissant, s'il vous plaît.
ordering at a café or restaurant.en: I'd like a coffee and a croissant, please.
ordering at a café or restaurant.pt: Eu queria um café e um croissant, por favor.

ordering at a café or restaurant.text: Est-ce que vous avez une table pour deux ?
ordering at a café or restaurant.en: Do you have a table for two?
ordering at a café or restaurant.pt: Vocês têm uma mesa para dois?

ordering at a café or restaurant.text: Nous allons prendre le menu du jour.
ordering at a café or restaurant.en: We're going to have the set menu of the day.
ordering at a café or restaurant.pt: Nós vamos pedir o prato do dia.

ordering at a café or restaurant.text: L'addition, s'il vous plaît, nous sommes pressés.
ordering at a café or restaurant.en: The bill, please, we're in a hurry.
ordering at a café or restaurant.pt: A conta, por favor, estamos com pressa.

ordering at a café or restaurant.text: J'ai commandé une salade, mais je n'ai rien reçu.
ordering at a café or restaurant.en: I ordered a salad, but I haven't received anything.
ordering at a café or restaurant.pt: Eu pedi uma salada, mas não recebi nada.

ordering at a café or restaurant.text: Qu'est-ce que vous recommandez comme dessert ce soir ?
ordering at a café or restaurant.en: What do you recommend for dessert tonight?
ordering at a café or restaurant.pt: O que você recomenda de sobremesa hoje à noite?

ordering at a café or restaurant.text: Marie a pris un thé au citron.
ordering at a café or restaurant.en: Marie had a lemon tea.
ordering at a café or restaurant.pt: A Marie pediu um chá de limão.

ordering at a café or restaurant.text: Je vais goûter la soupe de légumes aujourd'hui.
ordering at a café or restaurant.en: I'm going to try the vegetable soup today.
ordering at a café or restaurant.pt: Hoje eu vou experimentar a sopa de legumes.

ordering at a café or restaurant.text: Est-ce qu'on peut payer par carte ici ?
ordering at a café or restaurant.en: Can we pay by card here?
ordering at a café or restaurant.pt: Dá para pagar com cartão aqui?

ordering at a café or restaurant.text: Le serveur nous a apporté de l'eau gazeuse.
ordering at a café or restaurant.en: The waiter brought us sparkling water.
ordering at a café or restaurant.pt: O garçom nos trouxe água com gás.

ordering at a café or restaurant.text: Pour moi, ce sera un steak bien cuit.
ordering at a café or restaurant.en: For me, it'll be a well-done steak.
ordering at a café or restaurant.pt: Para mim, vai ser um bife bem passado.

ordering at a café or restaurant.text: Vous voulez une carafe d'eau avec votre repas ?
ordering at a café or restaurant.en: Would you like a jug of water with your meal?
ordering at a café or restaurant.pt: Você quer uma jarra de água com a refeição?

ordering at a café or restaurant.text: Nous avons réservé une table au nom de Martin.
ordering at a café or restaurant.en: We booked a table under the name Martin.
ordering at a café or restaurant.pt: Nós reservamos uma mesa no nome de Martin.

ordering at a café or restaurant.text: Ce restaurant est toujours plein le samedi soir.
ordering at a café or restaurant.en: This restaurant is always full on Saturday nights.
ordering at a café or restaurant.pt: Este restaurante está sempre cheio no sábado à noite.

ordering at a café or restaurant.text: Je ne mange pas de viande, vous avez autre chose ?
ordering at a café or restaurant.en: I don't eat meat, do you have anything else?
ordering at a café or restaurant.pt: Eu não como carne, vocês têm outra coisa?

ordering at a café or restaurant.text: Paul va prendre une bière et des frites.
ordering at a café or restaurant.en: Paul is going to have a beer and some fries.
ordering at a café or restaurant.pt: O Paul vai pedir uma cerveja e batatas fritas.

ordering at a café or restaurant.text: J'ai adoré le gâteau au chocolat !
ordering at a café or restaurant.en: I loved the chocolate cake!
ordering at a café or restaurant.pt: Eu adorei o bolo de chocolate!

ordering at a café or restaurant.text: Vous pouvez m'apporter le sel, s'il vous plaît ?
ordering at a café or restaurant.en: Could you bring me the salt, please?
ordering at a café or restaurant.pt: Você pode me trazer o sal, por favor?

ordering at a café or restaurant.text: On a attendu notre plat pendant trente minutes.
ordering at a café or restaurant.en: We waited thirty minutes for our dish.
ordering at a café or restaurant.pt: A gente esperou o nosso prato por trinta minutos.

ordering at a café or restaurant.text: Est-ce que le service est compris dans le prix ?
ordering at a café or restaurant.en: Is the service charge included in the price?
ordering at a café or restaurant.pt: O serviço está incluído no preço?

ordering at a café or restaurant.text: Je vais boire un jus d'orange pressé.
ordering at a café or restaurant.en: I'm going to have a freshly squeezed orange juice.
ordering at a café or restaurant.pt: Eu vou tomar um suco de laranja natural.

ordering at a café or restaurant.text: Les enfants ont partagé une grande pizza.
ordering at a café or restaurant.en: The children shared a large pizza.
ordering at a café or restaurant.pt: As crianças dividiram uma pizza grande.

ordering at a café or restaurant.text: Il y a une terrasse derrière le café.
ordering at a café or restaurant.en: There's a terrace behind the café.
ordering at a café or restaurant.pt: Tem uma área externa atrás do café.

ordering at a café or restaurant.text: Excusez-moi, ce n'est pas ce que j'ai commandé.
ordering at a café or restaurant.en: Excuse me, this isn't what I ordered.
ordering at a café or restaurant.pt: Com licença, não foi isso que eu pedi.

ordering at a café or restaurant.text: Vous désirez autre chose avec votre café ?
ordering at a café or restaurant.en: Would you like anything else with your coffee?
ordering at a café or restaurant.pt: Deseja mais alguma coisa com o seu café?

ordering at a café or restaurant.text: Nous allons laisser un pourboire au serveur.
ordering at a café or restaurant.en: We're going to leave the waiter a tip.
ordering at a café or restaurant.pt: Nós vamos deixar uma gorjeta para o garçom.

ordering at a café or restaurant.text: Sophie a choisi le poisson avec du riz.
ordering at a café or restaurant.en: Sophie chose the fish with rice.
ordering at a café or restaurant.pt: A Sophie escolheu o peixe com arroz.

ordering at a café or restaurant.text: Le menu du midi coûte quinze euros.
ordering at a café or restaurant.en: The lunch menu costs fifteen euros.
ordering at a café or restaurant.pt: O menu do almoço custa quinze euros.

ordering at a café or restaurant.text: Je peux voir la carte des vins ?
ordering at a café or restaurant.en: Can I see the wine list?
ordering at a café or restaurant.pt: Posso ver a carta de vinhos?

ordering at a café or restaurant.text: Un croissant et deux cafés, c'est combien ?
ordering at a café or restaurant.en: How much is a croissant and two coffees?
ordering at a café or restaurant.pt: Um croissant e dois cafés, quanto é?

ordering at a café or restaurant.text: Ils ont mangé dans un petit restaurant italien.
ordering at a café or restaurant.en: They ate at a small Italian restaurant.
ordering at a café or restaurant.pt: Eles comeram num pequeno restaurante italiano.

ordering at a café or restaurant.text: Je prends un café crème, sans sucre.
ordering at a café or restaurant.en: I'll have a coffee with milk, no sugar.
ordering at a café or restaurant.pt: Vou querer um café com leite, sem açúcar.

ordering at a café or restaurant.text: Ce soir, on va dîner chez Luigi.
ordering at a café or restaurant.en: Tonight we're going to have dinner at Luigi's.
ordering at a café or restaurant.pt: Hoje à noite, a gente vai jantar no Luigi.

ordering at a café or restaurant.text: La cuisine ferme à vingt-deux heures.
ordering at a café or restaurant.en: The kitchen closes at 10 p.m.
ordering at a café or restaurant.pt: A cozinha fecha às vinte e duas horas.

ordering at a café or restaurant.text: Vous avez des plats végétariens sur la carte ?
ordering at a café or restaurant.en: Do you have vegetarian dishes on the menu?
ordering at a café or restaurant.pt: Vocês têm pratos vegetarianos no cardápio?

ordering at a café or restaurant.text: J'ai oublié de demander du pain.
ordering at a café or restaurant.en: I forgot to ask for bread.
ordering at a café or restaurant.pt: Eu esqueci de pedir pão.

ordering at a café or restaurant.text: Le poulet est servi avec des légumes.
ordering at a café or restaurant.en: The chicken is served with vegetables.
ordering at a café or restaurant.pt: O frango é servido com legumes.

ordering at a café or restaurant.text: Tu veux partager une entrée avec moi ?
ordering at a café or restaurant.en: Do you want to share a starter with me?
ordering at a café or restaurant.pt: Você quer dividir uma entrada comigo?

ordering at a café or restaurant.text: Nous avons bien mangé, merci beaucoup !
ordering at a café or restaurant.en: We ate really well, thank you very much!
ordering at a café or restaurant.pt: Nós comemos muito bem, muito obrigado!

ordering at a café or restaurant.text: Une table près de la fenêtre, c'est possible ?
ordering at a café or restaurant.en: Is a table by the window possible?
ordering at a café or restaurant.pt: Uma mesa perto da janela, é possível?

travel and directions.text: Excusez-moi, où est la gare, s'il vous plaît ?
travel and directions.en: Excuse me, where is the train station, please?
travel and directions.pt: Com licença, onde fica a estação de trem, por favor?

travel and directions.text: Tournez à gauche après la boulangerie.
travel and directions.en: Turn left after the bakery.
travel and directions.pt: Vire à esquerda depois da padaria.

travel and directions.text: Le musée est à dix minutes à pied.
travel and directions.en: The museum is a ten-minute walk away.
travel and directions.pt: O museu fica a dez minutos a pé.

travel and directions.text: Nous allons prendre le train pour Lyon demain.
travel and directions.en: We're going to take the train to Lyon tomorrow.
travel and directions.pt: Nós vamos pegar o trem para Lyon amanhã.

travel and directions.text: J'ai perdu mon billet dans le métro.
travel and directions.en: I lost my ticket in the metro.
travel and directions.pt: Eu perdi minha passagem no metrô.

travel and directions.text: Continuez tout droit jusqu'au feu rouge.
travel and directions.en: Keep going straight until the traffic light.
travel and directions.pt: Siga em frente até o semáforo.

travel and directions.text: Est-ce que ce bus va au centre-ville ?
travel and directions.en: Does this bus go to the town centre?
travel and directions.pt: Esse ônibus vai para o centro?

travel and directions.text: Notre avion part à huit heures du matin.
travel and directions.en: Our plane leaves at eight in the morning.
travel and directions.pt: Nosso avião sai às oito da manhã.

travel and directions.text: Ils ont visité Marseille l'été dernier.
travel and directions.en: They visited Marseille last summer.
travel and directions.pt: Eles visitaram Marselha no verão passado.

travel and directions.text: Je cherche l'arrêt de bus le plus proche.
travel and directions.en: I'm looking for the nearest bus stop.
travel and directions.pt: Estou procurando o ponto de ônibus mais próximo.

travel and directions.text: Il faut changer de ligne à la prochaine station.
travel and directions.en: You have to change lines at the next station.
travel and directions.pt: É preciso trocar de linha na próxima estação.

travel and directions.text: Combien coûte un aller-retour pour Bordeaux ?
travel and directions.en: How much is a return ticket to Bordeaux?
travel and directions.pt: Quanto custa uma passagem de ida e volta para Bordeaux?

travel and directions.text: Claire a raté son train ce matin.
travel and directions.en: Claire missed her train this morning.
travel and directions.pt: A Claire perdeu o trem hoje de manhã.

travel and directions.text: L'hôtel se trouve à côté de la plage.
travel and directions.en: The hotel is next to the beach.
travel and directions.pt: O hotel fica ao lado da praia.

travel and directions.text: Vous pouvez me montrer sur la carte ?
travel and directions.en: Can you show me on the map?
travel and directions.pt: Você pode me mostrar no mapa?

travel and directions.text: Nous sommes arrivés à Paris hier soir.
travel and directions.en: We arrived in Paris last night.
travel and directions.pt: Nós chegamos a Paris ontem à noite.

travel and directions.text: Prenez la deuxième rue à droite.
travel and directions.en: Take the second street on the right.
travel and directions.pt: Pegue a segunda rua à direita.

travel and directions.text: Le voyage en voiture dure environ trois heures.
travel and directions.en: The trip by car takes about three hours.
travel and directions.pt: A viagem de carro dura umas três horas.

travel and directions.text: Je vais louer un vélo pour visiter la ville.
travel and directions.en: I'm going to rent a bike to visit the city.
travel and directions.pt: Vou alugar uma bicicleta para conhecer a cidade.

travel and directions.text: Où est-ce que je peux acheter un ticket ?
travel and directions.en: Where can I buy a ticket?
travel and directions.pt: Onde eu posso comprar um bilhete?

travel and directions.text: Le train a eu une heure de retard.
travel and directions.en: The train was an hour late.
travel and directions.pt: O trem atrasou uma hora.

travel and directions.text: Thomas va voyager en Espagne en juillet.
travel and directions.en: Thomas is going to travel to Spain in July.
travel and directions.pt: O Thomas vai viajar para a Espanha em julho.

travel and directions.text: La banque est au coin de la rue.
travel and directions.en: The bank is on the corner of the street.
travel and directions.pt: O banco fica na esquina.

travel and directions.text: C'est loin d'ici, la cathédrale ?
travel and directions.en: Is the cathedral far from here?
travel and directions.pt: A catedral fica longe daqui?

travel and directions.text: J'ai réservé une chambre pour trois nuits.
travel and directions.en: I booked a room for three nights.
travel and directions.pt: Eu reservei um quarto para três noites.

travel and directions.text: Il y a des taxis devant l'aéroport.
travel and directions.en: There are taxis in front of the airport.
travel and directions.pt: Tem táxis na frente do aeroporto.

travel and directions.text: On s'est perdus dans les petites rues.
travel and directions.en: We got lost in the little streets.
travel and directions.pt: A gente se perdeu nas ruazinhas.

travel and directions.text: Traversez le pont et vous êtes arrivé.
travel and directions.en: Cross the bridge and you're there.
travel and directions.pt: Atravesse a ponte e você chegou.

travel and directions.text: Ma valise est trop lourde pour l'avion.
travel and directions.en: My suitcase is too heavy for the plane.
travel and directions.pt: Minha mala está pesada demais para o avião.

travel and directions.text: Le prochain bus passe dans cinq minutes.
travel and directions.en: The next bus comes in five minutes.
travel and directions.pt: O próximo ônibus passa daqui a cinco minutos.

travel and directions.text: Nous allons partir en vacances à la montagne.
travel and directions.en: We're going on holiday to the mountains.
travel and directions.pt: Nós vamos sair de férias para as montanhas.

travel and directions.text: À quel arrêt est-ce que je dois descendre ?
travel and directions.en: Which stop do I need to get off at?
travel and directions.pt: Em qual parada eu tenho que descer?

travel and directions.text: J'ai oublié mon passeport à la maison !
travel and directions.en: I forgot my passport at home!
travel and directions.pt: Esqueci meu passaporte em casa!

travel and directions.text: La sortie est au bout du couloir.
travel and directions.en: The exit is at the end of the corridor.
travel and directions.pt: A saída fica no fim do corredor.

travel and directions.text: Léa a pris le bateau pour la Corse.
travel and directions.en: Léa took the boat to Corsica.
travel and directions.pt: A Léa pegou o barco para a Córsega.

travel and directions.text: Il faut valider le ticket avant de monter.
travel and directions.en: You have to validate the ticket before getting on.
travel and directions.pt: É preciso validar o bilhete antes de embarcar.

travel and directions.text: Le parking est derrière le supermarché.
travel and directions.en: The car park is behind the supermarket.
travel and directions.pt: O estacionamento fica atrás do supermercado.

travel and directions.text: Tu connais le chemin pour aller au stade ?
travel and directions.en: Do you know the way to the stadium?
travel and directions.pt: Você sabe o caminho para o estádio?

travel and directions.text: On va faire le tour de la ville en bus.
travel and directions.en: We're going to tour the city by bus.
travel and directions.pt: A gente vai dar uma volta pela cidade de ônibus.

shopping.text: Combien coûte ce pull bleu, s'il vous plaît ?
shopping.en: How much is this blue sweater, please?
shopping.pt: Quanto custa esta blusa azul, por favor?

shopping.text: Je cherche une robe pour un mariage.
shopping.en: I'm looking for a dress for a wedding.
shopping.pt: Estou procurando um vestido para um casamento.

shopping.text: Vous avez cette chemise en taille M ?
shopping.en: Do you have this shirt in a medium?
shopping.pt: Vocês têm esta camisa no tamanho M?

shopping.text: J'ai acheté des chaussures en soldes hier.
shopping.en: I bought some shoes on sale yesterday.
shopping.pt: Ontem eu comprei uns sapatos na liquidação.

shopping.text: Les cabines d'essayage sont au fond du magasin.
shopping.en: The fitting rooms are at the back of the shop.
shopping.pt: Os provadores ficam no fundo da loja.

shopping.text: Nous allons faire les courses au marché samedi.
shopping.en: We're going to do the shopping at the market on Saturday.
shopping.pt: Nós vamos fazer compras na feira no sábado.

shopping.text: Ce pantalon est un peu trop grand pour moi.
shopping.en: These trousers are a bit too big for me.
shopping.pt: Esta calça está um pouco grande demais para mim.

shopping.text: Est-ce que je peux payer en espèces ?
shopping.en: Can I pay in cash?
shopping.pt: Posso pagar em dinheiro?

shopping.text: Julie a trouvé un joli sac pour sa mère.
shopping.en: Julie found a nice bag for her mother.
shopping.pt: A Julie encontrou uma bolsa bonita para a mãe dela.

shopping.text: Le magasin ouvre à neuf heures et demie.
shopping.en: The shop opens at half past nine.
shopping.pt: A loja abre às nove e meia.

shopping.text: Je voudrais un kilo de pommes, s'il vous plaît.
shopping.en: I'd like a kilo of apples, please.
shopping.pt: Eu queria um quilo de maçãs, por favor.

shopping.text: Vous pouvez faire un paquet cadeau ?
shopping.en: Can you gift-wrap it?
shopping.pt: Você pode fazer um pacote de presente?

shopping.text: Il a rendu le jean parce qu'il est trop petit.
shopping.en: He returned the jeans because they're too small.
shopping.pt: Ele devolveu o jeans porque está pequeno demais.

shopping.text: Les fraises sont à quatre euros le kilo.
shopping.en: Strawberries are four euros a kilo.
shopping.pt: Os morangos estão a quatro euros o quilo.

shopping.text: J'ai oublié ma liste de courses à la maison.
shopping.en: I left my shopping list at home.
shopping.pt: Esqueci minha lista de compras em casa.

shopping.text: Ces bottes sont confortables, je les prends.
shopping.en: These boots are comfortable, I'll take them.
shopping.pt: Estas botas são confortáveis, vou levar.

shopping.text: On peut échanger cet article sans ticket ?
shopping.en: Can we exchange this item without a receipt?
shopping.pt: Dá para trocar este produto sem nota?

shopping.text: Le supermarché est fermé le dimanche après-midi.
shopping.en: The supermarket is closed on Sunday afternoons.
shopping.pt: O supermercado fica fechado no domingo à tarde.

shopping.text: Je vais acheter du pain à la boulangerie.
shopping.en: I'm going to buy bread at the bakery.
shopping.pt: Vou comprar pão na padaria.

shopping.text: Vous avez la même veste en noir ?
shopping.en: Do you have the same jacket in black?
shopping.pt: Vocês têm a mesma jaqueta em preto?

shopping.text: Marc a dépensé trop d'argent ce mois-ci.
shopping.en: Marc spent too much money this month.
shopping.pt: O Marc gastou dinheiro demais este mês.

shopping.text: Il me faut un sac, s'il vous plaît.
shopping.en: I need a bag, please.
shopping.pt: Preciso de uma sacola, por favor.

shopping.text: Cette boutique vend des vêtements d'occasion.
shopping.en: This shop sells second-hand clothes.
shopping.pt: Esta loja vende roupas usadas.

shopping.text: Je peux essayer ces lunettes de soleil ?
shopping.en: Can I try on these sunglasses?
shopping.pt: Posso experimentar estes óculos de sol?

shopping.text: Nous avons acheté un nouveau canapé pour le salon.
shopping.en: We bought a new sofa for the living room.
shopping.pt: Nós compramos um sofá novo para a sala.

shopping.text: C'est trop cher, vous avez moins cher ?
shopping.en: It's too expensive, do you have anything cheaper?
shopping.pt: Está caro demais, vocês têm algo mais barato?

shopping.text: Le vendeur m'a donné une réduction de dix pour cent.
shopping.en: The salesman gave me a ten percent discount.
shopping.pt: O vendedor me deu um desconto de dez por cento.

shopping.text: Elle va commander une lampe sur internet.
shopping.en: She's going to order a lamp online.
shopping.pt: Ela vai encomendar uma luminária pela internet.

shopping.text: Où est le rayon des produits laitiers ?
shopping.en: Where is the dairy aisle?
shopping.pt: Onde fica a seção de laticínios?

shopping.text: Je prends six œufs et un litre de lait.
shopping.en: I'll take six eggs and a litre of milk.
shopping.pt: Vou levar seis ovos e um litro de leite.

shopping.text: Les soldes commencent la semaine prochaine.
shopping.en: The sales start next week.
shopping.pt: A liquidação começa na semana que vem.

shopping.text: Tu as pensé à acheter du fromage ?
shopping.en: Did you remember to buy cheese?
shopping.pt: Você lembrou de comprar queijo?

shopping.text: J'ai perdu le ticket de caisse.
shopping.en: I lost the receipt.
shopping.pt: Eu perdi o comprovante da compra.

shopping.text: La caisse numéro trois est libre, madame.
shopping.en: Checkout number three is free, madam.
shopping.pt: O caixa número três está livre, senhora.

shopping.text: Ces tomates viennent de la région.
shopping.en: These tomatoes are from the local area.
shopping.pt: Estes tomates são da região.

shopping.text: Je vais offrir un livre à mon frère.
shopping.en: I'm going to give my brother a book.
shopping.pt: Vou dar um livro de presente para o meu irmão.

shopping.text: Le centre commercial est plein le samedi.
shopping.en: The shopping centre is packed on Saturdays.
shopping.pt: O shopping fica lotado aos sábados.

shopping.text: Et avec ça, ce sera tout, madame ?
shopping.en: Anything else, or will that be all, madam?
shopping.pt: Mais alguma coisa, ou é só isso, senhora?

shopping.text: Anne a acheté un cadeau pour l'anniversaire de Paul.
shopping.en: Anne bought a present for Paul's birthday.
shopping.pt: A Anne comprou um presente para o aniversário do Paul.

shopping.text: Cette couleur vous va très bien !
shopping.en: That colour really suits you!
shopping.pt: Essa cor fica muito bem em você!

work and meetings.text: La réunion commence à dix heures précises.
work and meetings.en: The meeting starts at ten o'clock sharp.
work and meetings.pt: A reunião começa às dez em ponto.

work and meetings.text: J'ai envoyé le rapport à mon chef ce matin.
work and meetings.en: I sent the report to my boss this morning.
work and meetings.pt: Mandei o relatório para o meu chefe hoje de manhã.

work and meetings.text: Nous allons présenter le projet aux clients jeudi.
work and meetings.en: We're going to present the project to the clients on Thursday.
work and meetings.pt: Nós vamos apresentar o projeto aos clientes na quinta.

work and meetings.text: Est-ce que tu peux imprimer ce document ?
work and meetings.en: Can you print this document?
work and meetings.pt: Você pode imprimir este documento?

work and meetings.text: Mon collègue travaille à la maison le vendredi.
work and meetings.en: My colleague works from home on Fridays.
work and meetings.pt: Meu colega trabalha de casa às sextas.

work and meetings.text: La réunion a duré deux heures, c'est trop long !
work and meetings.en: The meeting lasted two hours, that's too long!
work and meetings.pt: A reunião durou duas horas, é tempo demais!

work and meetings.text: Je vais prendre des notes pendant la présentation.
work and meetings.en: I'm going to take notes during the presentation.
work and meetings.pt: Vou fazer anotações durante a apresentação.

work and meetings.text: Le directeur est en déplacement cette semaine.
work and meetings.en: The director is away on business this week.
work and meetings.pt: O diretor está viajando a trabalho esta semana.

work and meetings.text: On peut déplacer la réunion à demain ?
work and meetings.en: Can we move the meeting to tomorrow?
work and meetings.pt: Dá para passar a reunião para amanhã?

work and meetings.text: Sarah a commencé un nouveau travail en mars.
work and meetings.en: Sarah started a new job in March.
work and meetings.pt: A Sarah começou num emprego novo em março.

work and meetings.text: J'ai beaucoup de mails à lire aujourd'hui.
work and meetings.en: I have a lot of emails to read today.
work and meetings.pt: Tenho muitos e-mails para ler hoje.

work and meetings.text: Qui va préparer l'ordre du jour ?
work and meetings.en: Who's going to prepare the agenda?
work and meetings.pt: Quem vai preparar a pauta?

work and meetings.text: Nos bureaux sont au troisième étage.
work and meetings.en: Our offices are on the third floor.
work and meetings.pt: Nossos escritórios ficam no terceiro andar.

work and meetings.text: Il a fini son travail à dix-neuf heures.
work and meetings.en: He finished his work at 7 p.m.
work and meetings.pt: Ele terminou o trabalho às dezenove horas.

work and meetings.text: Je suis en réunion, je te rappelle plus tard.
work and meetings.en: I'm in a meeting, I'll call you back later.
work and meetings.pt: Estou em reunião, te ligo mais tarde.

work and meetings.text: L'équipe va déjeuner ensemble vendredi midi.
work and meetings.en: The team is going to have lunch together on Friday.
work and meetings.pt: A equipe vai almoçar junta na sexta.

work and meetings.text: Vous avez des questions sur le budget ?
work and meetings.en: Do you have any questions about the budget?
work and meetings.pt: Vocês têm alguma pergunta sobre o orçamento?

work and meetings.text: J'ai oublié mon badge à la maison.
work and meetings.en: I left my badge at home.
work and meetings.pt: Esqueci meu crachá em casa.

work and meetings.text: La salle de réunion est réservée jusqu'à midi.
work and meetings.en: The meeting room is booked until noon.
work and meetings.pt: A sala de reunião está reservada até o meio-dia.

work and meetings.text: Nous avons signé le contrat avec le nouveau client.
work and meetings.en: We signed the contract with the new client.
work and meetings.pt: Nós assinamos o contrato com o novo cliente.

work and meetings.text: Mon ordinateur ne marche pas ce matin.
work and meetings.en: My computer isn't working this morning.
work and meetings.pt: Meu computador não está funcionando hoje de manhã.

work and meetings.text: Elle va prendre ses congés en août.
work and meetings.en: She's going to take her leave in August.
work and meetings.pt: Ela vai tirar férias em agosto.

work and meetings.text: Le projet doit être fini avant la fin du mois.
work and meetings.en: The project has to be finished before the end of the month.
work and meetings.pt: O projeto tem que estar pronto antes do fim do mês.

work and meetings.text: Tu as vu le message de Pierre ?
work and meetings.en: Have you seen Pierre's message?
work and meetings.pt: Você viu a mensagem do Pierre?

work and meetings.text: On a parlé des nouveaux horaires pendant la réunion.
work and meetings.en: We talked about the new schedule during the meeting.
work and meetings.pt: A gente falou dos novos horários durante a reunião.

work and meetings.text: Je commence à huit heures et je finis à seize heures.
work and meetings.en: I start at eight and finish at four.
work and meetings.pt: Eu começo às oito e termino às dezesseis horas.

work and meetings.text: Le stagiaire est arrivé lundi dernier.
work and meetings.en: The intern arrived last Monday.
work and meetings.pt: O estagiário chegou na segunda passada.

work and meetings.text: Est-ce que la visioconférence fonctionne bien ?
work and meetings.en: Is the video call working properly?
work and meetings.pt: A videoconferência está funcionando bem?

work and meetings.text: Je vais écrire un mail à toute l'équipe.
work and meetings.en: I'm going to write an email to the whole team.
work and meetings.pt: Vou escrever um e-mail para a equipe toda.

work and meetings.text: Nous travaillons dans une petite entreprise.
work and meetings.en: We work for a small company.
work and meetings.pt: Nós trabalhamos numa empresa pequena.

work and meetings.text: Mon chef m'a demandé de rester plus tard.
work and meetings.en: My boss asked me to stay later.
work and meetings.pt: Meu chefe me pediu para ficar até mais tarde.

work and meetings.text: La pause café est à quinze heures.
work and meetings.en: The coffee break is at 3 p.m.
work and meetings.pt: A pausa para o café é às quinze horas.

work and meetings.text: Qui a pris le compte rendu de la réunion ?
work and meetings.en: Who took the minutes of the meeting?
work and meetings.pt: Quem fez a ata da reunião?

work and meetings.text: Lucas va changer de service le mois prochain.
work and meetings.en: Lucas is going to change departments next month.
work and meetings.pt: O Lucas vai mudar de setor no mês que vem.

work and meetings.text: J'ai un entretien d'embauche mardi matin.
work and meetings.en: I have a job interview on Tuesday morning.
work and meetings.pt: Tenho uma entrevista de emprego na terça de manhã.

work and meetings.text: Le client a annulé le rendez-vous de demain.
work and meetings.en: The client cancelled tomorrow's meeting.
work and meetings.pt: O cliente cancelou a reunião de amanhã.

work and meetings.text: Tu peux partager ton écran, s'il te plaît ?
work and meetings.en: Can you share your screen, please?
work and meetings.pt: Você pode compartilhar a sua tela, por favor?

work and meetings.text: Elle travaille comme comptable depuis cinq ans.
work and meetings.en: She has been working as an accountant for five years.
work and meetings.pt: Ela trabalha como contadora há cinco anos.

work and meetings.text: Nous allons embaucher deux personnes cette année.
work and meetings.en: We're going to hire two people this year.
work and meetings.pt: Nós vamos contratar duas pessoas este ano.

work and meetings.text: Bravo, tu as fait une très bonne présentation !
work and meetings.en: Well done, you gave a really good presentation!
work and meetings.pt: Parabéns, você fez uma apresentação muito boa!

family and friends.text: Ma sœur habite à Toulouse avec son mari.
family and friends.en: My sister lives in Toulouse with her husband.
family and friends.pt: Minha irmã mora em Toulouse com o marido.

family and friends.text: J'ai deux frères et une petite sœur.
family and friends.en: I have two brothers and a little sister.
family and friends.pt: Eu tenho dois irmãos e uma irmã mais nova.

family and friends.text: Nous allons fêter l'anniversaire de mamie dimanche.
family and friends.en: We're going to celebrate Grandma's birthday on Sunday.
family and friends.pt: Nós vamos comemorar o aniversário da vovó no domingo.

family and friends.text: Mon meilleur ami s'appelle Hugo, il est très drôle.
family and friends.en: My best friend is called Hugo, he's very funny.
family and friends.pt: Meu melhor amigo se chama Hugo, ele é muito engraçado.

family and friends.text: Mes parents sont venus nous voir le week-end dernier.
family and friends.en: My parents came to see us last weekend.
family and friends.pt: Meus pais vieram visitar a gente no fim de semana passado.

family and friends.text: Tu as des cousins en France ?
family and friends.en: Do you have cousins in France?
family and friends.pt: Você tem primos na França?

family and friends.text: Ma fille va commencer l'école en septembre.
family and friends.en: My daughter is going to start school in September.
family and friends.pt: Minha filha vai começar a escola em setembro.

family and friends.text: Mon grand-père a quatre-vingts ans aujourd'hui.
family and friends.en: My grandfather is eighty today.
family and friends.pt: Meu avô faz oitenta anos hoje.

family and friends.text: On a dîné chez des amis samedi soir.
family and friends.en: We had dinner at some friends' place on Saturday night.
family and friends.pt: A gente jantou na casa de uns amigos no sábado à noite.

family and friends.text: Camille ressemble beaucoup à sa mère.
family and friends.en: Camille looks a lot like her mother.
family and friends.pt: A Camille se parece muito com a mãe.

family and friends.text: Mon oncle travaille dans une banque à Lille.
family and friends.en: My uncle works at a bank in Lille.
family and friends.pt: Meu tio trabalha num banco em Lille.

family and friends.text: Les enfants jouent dans le jardin avec leur chien.
family and friends.en: The children are playing in the garden with their dog.
family and friends.pt: As crianças estão brincando no quintal com o cachorro.

family and friends.text: J'ai rencontré ma femme à l'université.
family and friends.en: I met my wife at university.
family and friends.pt: Eu conheci minha esposa na faculdade.

family and friends.text: Ton frère est plus âgé que toi ?
family and friends.en: Is your brother older than you?
family and friends.pt: Seu irmão é mais velho que você?

family and friends.text: Nous allons passer Noël chez mes beaux-parents.
family and friends.en: We're going to spend Christmas at my in-laws'.
family and friends.pt: Nós vamos passar o Natal na casa dos meus sogros.

family and friends.text: Mes amis m'ont fait une surprise pour mon anniversaire.
family and friends.en: My friends threw me a surprise for my birthday.
family and friends.pt: Meus amigos me fizeram uma surpresa no meu aniversário.

family and friends.text: Mon fils a eu son permis la semaine dernière.
family and friends.en: My son got his driving licence last week.
family and friends.pt: Meu filho tirou a carteira de motorista semana passada.

family and friends.text: Elle téléphone à sa mère tous les dimanches.
family and friends.en: She calls her mother every Sunday.
family and friends.pt: Ela liga para a mãe todo domingo.

family and friends.text: Mes cousins viennent dîner ce soir.
family and friends.en: My cousins are coming for dinner tonight.
family and friends.pt: Meus primos vêm jantar hoje à noite.

family and friends.text: Julien et Emma se sont mariés en juin.
family and friends.en: Julien and Emma got married in June.
family and friends.pt: O Julien e a Emma se casaram em junho.

family and friends.text: Ma tante a trois enfants et deux chats.
family and friends.en: My aunt has three children and two cats.
family and friends.pt: Minha tia tem três filhos e dois gatos.

family and friends.text: On se voit souvent avec les amis du lycée.
family and friends.en: We often see our friends from high school.
family and friends.pt: A gente se encontra bastante com os amigos do colégio.

family and friends.text: Mon petit frère a douze ans.
family and friends.en: My little brother is twelve.
family and friends.pt: Meu irmão mais novo tem doze anos.

family and friends.text: Tu vas inviter qui à ta fête ?
family and friends.en: Who are you going to invite to your party?
family and friends.pt: Quem você vai convidar para a sua festa?

family and friends.text: Ma grand-mère fait le meilleur gâteau du monde !
family and friends.en: My grandmother makes the best cake in the world!
family and friends.pt: Minha avó faz o melhor bolo do mundo!

family and friends.text: Notre bébé est né il y a deux mois.
family and friends.en: Our baby was born two months ago.
family and friends.pt: Nosso bebê nasceu há dois meses.

family and friends.text: Mes parents habitent à la campagne.
family and friends.en: My parents live in the countryside.
family and friends.pt: Meus pais moram no interior.

family and friends.text: Inès est mon amie depuis l'école primaire.
family and friends.en: Inès has been my friend since primary school.
family and friends.pt: A Inès é minha amiga desde o ensino fundamental.

family and friends.text: Mon père va prendre sa retraite l'année prochaine.
family and friends.en: My father is going to retire next year.
family and friends.pt: Meu pai vai se aposentar no ano que vem.

family and friends.text: J'ai appelé mon ami pour lui demander un conseil.
family and friends.en: I called my friend to ask him for advice.
family and friends.pt: Liguei para o meu amigo para pedir um conselho.

family and friends.text: Mes enfants se disputent tout le temps !
family and friends.en: My children argue all the time!
family and friends.pt: Meus filhos brigam o tempo todo!

family and friends.text: Mon mari cuisine mieux que moi.
family and friends.en: My husband cooks better than I do.
family and friends.pt: Meu marido cozinha melhor do que eu.

family and friends.text: Vous avez combien d'enfants, madame Dubois ?
family and friends.en: How many children do you have, Mrs Dubois?
family and friends.pt: Quantos filhos a senhora tem, dona Dubois?

family and friends.text: On a fait une grande fête de famille cet été.
family and friends.en: We had a big family party this summer.
family and friends.pt: A gente fez uma grande festa de família neste verão.

family and friends.text: Ma nièce est née la semaine dernière.
family and friends.en: My niece was born last week.
family and friends.pt: Minha sobrinha nasceu na semana passada.

family and friends.text: Je vais garder mes petits-enfants mercredi.
family and friends.en: I'm going to look after my grandchildren on Wednesday.
family and friends.pt: Vou cuidar dos meus netos na quarta.

family and friends.text: Notre famille se réunit pour les fêtes.
family and friends.en: Our family gets together for the holidays.
family and friends.pt: Nossa família se reúne nas festas de fim de ano.

family and friends.text: Antoine est le parrain de mon fils.
family and friends.en: Antoine is my son's godfather.
family and friends.pt: O Antoine é o padrinho do meu filho.

family and friends.text: Mes amis et moi, on part en week-end.
family and friends.en: My friends and I are going away for the weekend.
family and friends.pt: Eu e meus amigos vamos viajar no fim de semana.

family and friends.text: Ta sœur a trouvé un appartement à Nantes ?
family and friends.en: Has your sister found a flat in Nantes?
family and friends.pt: Sua irmã achou um apartamento em Nantes?

health and the doctor.text: J'ai mal à la tête depuis ce matin.
health and the doctor.en: I've had a headache since this morning.
health and the doctor.pt: Estou com dor de cabeça desde hoje de manhã.

health and the doctor.text: Je voudrais prendre rendez-vous avec le médecin.
health and the doctor.en: I'd like to make an appointment with the doctor.
health and the doctor.pt: Eu queria marcar uma consulta com o médico.

health and the doctor.text: Le docteur m'a donné des médicaments pour la toux.
health and the doctor.en: The doctor gave me some medicine for my cough.
health and the doctor.pt: O médico me deu remédios para a tosse.

health and the doctor.text: Tu as de la fièvre, reste au lit !
health and the doctor.en: You have a fever, stay in bed!
health and the doctor.pt: Você está com febre, fique na cama!

health and the doctor.text: Prenez ce sirop trois fois par jour.
health and the doctor.en: Take this syrup three times a day.
health and the doctor.pt: Tome este xarope três vezes por dia.

health and the doctor.text: Elle s'est cassé le bras au ski.
health and the doctor.en: She broke her arm skiing.
health and the doctor.pt: Ela quebrou o braço esquiando.

health and the doctor.text: Où est-ce que vous avez mal exactement ?
health and the doctor.en: Where exactly does it hurt?
health and the doctor.pt: Onde exatamente está doendo?

health and the doctor.text: Je vais à la pharmacie acheter de l'aspirine.
health and the doctor.en: I'm going to the pharmacy to buy some aspirin.
health and the doctor.pt: Vou à farmácia comprar aspirina.

health and the doctor.text: Mon fils est malade, il ne va pas à l'école.
health and the doctor.en: My son is ill, he isn't going to school.
health and the doctor.pt: Meu filho está doente, ele não vai à escola.

health and the doctor.text: Le dentiste m'a soigné une dent hier.
health and the doctor.en: The dentist treated one of my teeth yesterday.
health and the doctor.pt: Ontem o dentista tratou um dente meu.

health and the doctor.text: Vous êtes allergique à quelque chose ?
health and the doctor.en: Are you allergic to anything?
health and the doctor.pt: Você tem alergia a alguma coisa?

health and the doctor.text: Je dois faire une prise de sang demain.
health and the doctor.en: I have to have a blood test tomorrow.
health and the doctor.pt: Tenho que fazer um exame de sangue amanhã.

health and the doctor.text: Paul a attrapé un gros rhume.
health and the doctor.en: Paul caught a bad cold.
health and the doctor.pt: O Paul pegou um resfriado forte.

health and the doctor.text: Il faut boire beaucoup d'eau et se reposer.
health and the doctor.en: You need to drink lots of water and rest.
health and the doctor.pt: É preciso beber muita água e descansar.

health and the doctor.text: J'ai mal au ventre après le déjeuner.
health and the doctor.en: I have a stomach ache after lunch.
health and the doctor.pt: Estou com dor de barriga depois do almoço.

health and the doctor.text: Le médecin va vous examiner dans cinq minutes.
health and the doctor.en: The doctor will examine you in five minutes.
health and the doctor.pt: O médico vai examinar você daqui a cinco minutos.

health and the doctor.text: Elle ne fume plus depuis deux ans.
health and the doctor.en: She hasn't smoked for two years.
health and the doctor.pt: Ela não fuma mais há dois anos.

health and the doctor.text: Je me sens beaucoup mieux aujourd'hui, merci.
health and the doctor.en: I feel much better today, thank you.
health and the doctor.pt: Estou me sentindo bem melhor hoje, obrigado.

health and the doctor.text: Tu dois aller voir un médecin, c'est sérieux.
health and the doctor.en: You have to go and see a doctor, it's serious.
health and the doctor.pt: Você precisa ir ao médico, é sério.

health and the doctor.text: J'ai besoin d'une ordonnance pour ce médicament ?
health and the doctor.en: Do I need a prescription for this medicine?
health and the doctor.pt: Preciso de receita para este remédio?

health and the doctor.text: Nicolas s'est fait mal au genou en courant.
health and the doctor.en: Nicolas hurt his knee while running.
health and the doctor.pt: O Nicolas machucou o joelho correndo.

health and the doctor.text: Je vais faire du sport pour être en forme.
health and the doctor.en: I'm going to exercise to get in shape.
health and the doctor.pt: Vou fazer exercício para ficar em forma.

health and the doctor.text: Ma mère a passé une nuit à l'hôpital.
health and the doctor.en: My mother spent a night in hospital.
health and the doctor.pt: Minha mãe passou uma noite no hospital.

health and the doctor.text: Vous avez votre carte Vitale, s'il vous plaît ?
health and the doctor.en: Do you have your health insurance card, please?
health and the doctor.pt: Você está com o seu cartão do plano de saúde, por favor?

health and the doctor.text: Je tousse beaucoup la nuit, c'est fatigant.
health and the doctor.en: I cough a lot at night, it's exhausting.
health and the doctor.pt: Eu tusso muito à noite, é cansativo.

health and the doctor.text: L'infirmière m'a fait une piqûre.
health and the doctor.en: The nurse gave me an injection.
health and the doctor.pt: A enfermeira me deu uma injeção.

health and the doctor.text: Il faut prendre un comprimé avant chaque repas.
health and the doctor.en: You have to take one tablet before each meal.
health and the doctor.pt: É preciso tomar um comprimido antes de cada refeição.

health and the doctor.text: Je suis enrhumée, j'ai le nez qui coule.
health and the doctor.en: I have a cold, my nose is running.
health and the doctor.pt: Estou resfriada, meu nariz está escorrendo.

health and the doctor.text: Le docteur Morel reçoit sans rendez-vous le matin.
health and the doctor.en: Dr Morel sees patients without an appointment in the morning.
health and the doctor.pt: O doutor Morel atende sem hora marcada de manhã.

health and the doctor.text: Ouvrez la bouche et dites « ah ».
health and the doctor.en: Open your mouth and say "ah".
health and the doctor.pt: Abra a boca e diga "á".

health and the doctor.text: J'ai très mal dormi cette nuit.
health and the doctor.en: I slept really badly last night.
health and the doctor.pt: Dormi muito mal esta noite.

health and the doctor.text: Elle va chez l'ophtalmologue pour ses yeux.
health and the doctor.en: She's going to the eye doctor about her eyes.
health and the doctor.pt: Ela vai ao oftalmologista por causa dos olhos.

health and the doctor.text: Nous allons nous faire vacciner contre la grippe.
health and the doctor.en: We're going to get vaccinated against the flu.
health and the doctor.pt: Nós vamos tomar a vacina contra a gripe.

health and the doctor.text: Mon dos me fait mal quand je marche.
health and the doctor.en: My back hurts when I walk.
health and the doctor.pt: Minhas costas doem quando eu ando.

health and the doctor.text: Combien de fois par jour je prends ce médicament ?
health and the doctor.en: How many times a day do I take this medicine?
health and the doctor.pt: Quantas vezes por dia eu tomo este remédio?

health and the doctor.text: Le médecin m'a conseillé de manger moins de sucre.
health and the doctor.en: The doctor advised me to eat less sugar.
health and the doctor.pt: O médico me aconselhou a comer menos açúcar.

health and the doctor.text: J'ai appelé les urgences pour mon voisin.
health and the doctor.en: I called the emergency services for my neighbour.
health and the doctor.pt: Liguei para a emergência por causa do meu vizinho.

health and the doctor.text: Tu prends tes vitamines tous les matins ?
health and the doctor.en: Do you take your vitamins every morning?
health and the doctor.pt: Você toma suas vitaminas toda manhã?

health and the doctor.text: Bon rétablissement, repose-toi bien !
health and the doctor.en: Get well soon, get plenty of rest!
health and the doctor.pt: Melhoras, descanse bastante!

weather and seasons.text: Il fait très beau aujourd'hui, on sort ?
weather and seasons.en: The weather is lovely today, shall we go out?
weather and seasons.pt: O tempo está ótimo hoje, vamos sair?

weather and seasons.text: Il va pleuvoir cet après-midi, prends un parapluie.
weather and seasons.en: It's going to rain this afternoon, take an umbrella.
weather and seasons.pt: Vai chover hoje à tarde, leve um guarda-chuva.

weather and seasons.text: Il a neigé toute la nuit à la montagne.
weather and seasons.en: It snowed all night in the mountains.
weather and seasons.pt: Nevou a noite toda na montanha.

weather and seasons.text: En été, il fait chaud dans le sud.
weather and seasons.en: In summer, it's hot in the south.
weather and seasons.pt: No verão, faz calor no sul.

weather and seasons.text: Quel temps fait-il à Strasbourg en ce moment ?
weather and seasons.en: What's the weather like in Strasbourg right now?
weather and seasons.pt: Como está o tempo em Estrasburgo agora?

weather and seasons.text: J'adore l'automne et ses belles couleurs.
weather and seasons.en: I love autumn and its beautiful colours.
weather and seasons.pt: Eu adoro o outono e suas cores lindas.

weather and seasons.text: Il y a beaucoup de vent sur la plage.
weather and seasons.en: It's very windy on the beach.
weather and seasons.pt: Está ventando muito na praia.

weather and seasons.text: La météo annonce des orages pour demain.
weather and seasons.en: The forecast says there will be storms tomorrow.
weather and seasons.pt: A previsão do tempo anuncia tempestades para amanhã.

weather and seasons.text: Il fait moins cinq degrés ce matin !
weather and seasons.en: It's minus five degrees this morning!
weather and seasons.pt: Está fazendo cinco graus negativos hoje de manhã!

weather and seasons.text: Le printemps arrive, les fleurs commencent à pousser.
weather and seasons.en: Spring is coming, the flowers are starting to grow.
weather and seasons.pt: A primavera está chegando, as flores estão começando a nascer.

weather and seasons.text: On a eu un hiver très froid cette année.
weather and seasons.en: We had a very cold winter this year.
weather and seasons.pt: A gente teve um inverno muito frio este ano.

weather and seasons.text: Il fait trop chaud pour travailler dehors.
weather and seasons.en: It's too hot to work outside.
weather and seasons.pt: Está quente demais para trabalhar lá fora.

weather and seasons.text: Le ciel est gris, il va sûrement pleuvoir.
weather and seasons.en: The sky is grey, it's surely going to rain.
weather and seasons.pt: O céu está cinzento, com certeza vai chover.

weather and seasons.text: En hiver, je bois beaucoup de chocolat chaud.
weather and seasons.en: In winter, I drink a lot of hot chocolate.
weather and seasons.pt: No inverno, eu tomo muito chocolate quente.

weather and seasons.text: Il a fait beau tout le week-end.
weather and seasons.en: The weather was nice all weekend.
weather and seasons.pt: Fez tempo bom o fim de semana inteiro.

weather and seasons.text: Mets ton manteau, il fait froid dehors !
weather and seasons.en: Put your coat on, it's cold outside!
weather and seasons.pt: Coloque o casaco, está frio lá fora!

weather and seasons.text: Il y a du brouillard sur l'autoroute ce matin.
weather and seasons.en: There's fog on the motorway this morning.
weather and seasons.pt: Tem neblina na rodovia hoje de manhã.

weather and seasons.text: Quelle est ta saison préférée, Lucie ?
weather and seasons.en: What's your favourite season, Lucie?
weather and seasons.pt: Qual é a sua estação preferida, Lucie?

weather and seasons.text: Nous allons skier en février dans les Alpes.
weather and seasons.en: We're going skiing in the Alps in February.
weather and seasons.pt: Nós vamos esquiar nos Alpes em fevereiro.

weather and seasons.text: Il pleut depuis trois jours sans arrêt.
weather and seasons.en: It has been raining non-stop for three days.
weather and seasons.pt: Está chovendo sem parar há três dias.

weather and seasons.text: Le soleil se couche tard en juin.
weather and seasons.en: The sun sets late in June.
weather and seasons.pt: O sol se põe tarde em junho.

weather and seasons.text: Demain, il va faire vingt-cinq degrés.
weather and seasons.en: Tomorrow it's going to be twenty-five degrees.
weather and seasons.pt: Amanhã vai fazer vinte e cinco graus.

weather and seasons.text: J'ai oublié mon parapluie et je suis trempé.
weather and seasons.en: I forgot my umbrella and I'm soaked.
weather and seasons.pt: Esqueci meu guarda-chuva e estou encharcado.

weather and seasons.text: Les enfants ont fait un bonhomme de neige.
weather and seasons.en: The children made a snowman.
weather and seasons.pt: As crianças fizeram um boneco de neve.

weather and seasons.text: En automne, les feuilles tombent des arbres.
weather and seasons.en: In autumn, the leaves fall from the trees.
weather and seasons.pt: No outono, as folhas caem das árvores.

weather and seasons.text: Il fait doux pour un mois de novembre.
weather and seasons.en: It's mild for November.
weather and seasons.pt: Está um tempo ameno para novembro.

weather and seasons.text: On va à la plage s'il fait beau.
weather and seasons.en: We'll go to the beach if the weather is nice.
weather and seasons.pt: A gente vai à praia se fizer tempo bom.

weather and seasons.text: La température va baisser ce week-end.
weather and seasons.en: The temperature is going to drop this weekend.
weather and seasons.pt: A temperatura vai cair neste fim de semana.

weather and seasons.text: Il y a eu une grosse tempête en Bretagne.
weather and seasons.en: There was a big storm in Brittany.
weather and seasons.pt: Teve uma grande tempestade na Bretanha.

weather and seasons.text: Je n'aime pas la pluie, ça me rend triste.
weather and seasons.en: I don't like rain, it makes me sad.
weather and seasons.pt: Eu não gosto de chuva, ela me deixa triste.

weather and seasons.text: Cet été, il n'a presque pas plu.
weather and seasons.en: This summer, it hardly rained at all.
weather and seasons.pt: Neste verão, quase não choveu.

weather and seasons.text: Le vent a cassé une branche dans le jardin.
weather and seasons.en: The wind broke a branch in the garden.
weather and seasons.pt: O vento quebrou um galho no jardim.

weather and seasons.text: Tu as vu l'arc-en-ciel au-dessus du lac ?
weather and seasons.en: Did you see the rainbow over the lake?
weather and seasons.pt: Você viu o arco-íris em cima do lago?

weather and seasons.text: Il fait nuit très tôt en décembre.
weather and seasons.en: It gets dark very early in December.
weather and seasons.pt: Escurece muito cedo em dezembro.

weather and seasons.text: Il y a du soleil, mais il fait frais.
weather and seasons.en: It's sunny, but it's chilly.
weather and seasons.pt: Tem sol, mas está fresco.

weather and seasons.text: Les jours sont plus longs au printemps.
weather and seasons.en: The days are longer in spring.
weather and seasons.pt: Os dias são mais longos na primavera.

weather and seasons.text: En été, nous mangeons souvent dans le jardin.
weather and seasons.en: In summer, we often eat in the garden.
weather and seasons.pt: No verão, nós comemos muitas vezes no jardim.

weather and seasons.text: Il va neiger ce soir, fais attention sur la route.
weather and seasons.en: It's going to snow tonight, be careful on the road.
weather and seasons.pt: Vai nevar hoje à noite, tome cuidado na estrada.

weather and seasons.text: Il fait lourd, je pense qu'il va y avoir un orage.
weather and seasons.en: It's muggy, I think there's going to be a storm.
weather and seasons.pt: Está abafado, acho que vai ter uma tempestade.

weather and seasons.text: Quel beau temps pour une promenade !
weather and seasons.en: What lovely weather for a walk!
weather and seasons.pt: Que tempo bom para um passeio!

hobbies and weekends.text: Le samedi, je joue au tennis avec mon frère.
hobbies and weekends.en: On Saturdays, I play tennis with my brother.
hobbies and weekends.pt: Aos sábados, eu jogo tênis com o meu irmão.

hobbies and weekends.text: Qu'est-ce que tu fais ce week-end ?
hobbies and weekends.en: What are you doing this weekend?
hobbies and weekends.pt: O que você vai fazer neste fim de semana?

hobbies and weekends.text: Nous allons voir un film au cinéma ce soir.
hobbies and weekends.en: We're going to see a film at the cinema tonight.
hobbies and weekends.pt: Nós vamos ver um filme no cinema hoje à noite.

hobbies and weekends.text: J'ai lu un très bon roman cette semaine.
hobbies and weekends.en: I read a really good novel this week.
hobbies and weekends.pt: Eu li um romance muito bom esta semana.

hobbies and weekends.text: Elle fait du yoga deux fois par semaine.
hobbies and weekends.en: She does yoga twice a week.
hobbies and weekends.pt: Ela faz ioga duas vezes por semana.

hobbies and weekends.text: Le dimanche, on fait une balade en forêt.
hobbies and weekends.en: On Sundays, we go for a walk in the forest.
hobbies and weekends.pt: Aos domingos, a gente faz um passeio na floresta.

hobbies and weekends.text: Tu joues d'un instrument de musique ?
hobbies and weekends.en: Do you play a musical instrument?
hobbies and weekends.pt: Você toca algum instrumento musical?

hobbies and weekends.text: Martin a commencé des cours de guitare.
hobbies and weekends.en: Martin has started guitar lessons.
hobbies and weekends.pt: O Martin começou aulas de violão.

hobbies and weekends.text: Nous sommes allés à un concert vendredi soir.
hobbies and weekends.en: We went to a concert on Friday night.
hobbies and weekends.pt: Nós fomos a um show na sexta à noite.

hobbies and weekends.text: J'aime cuisiner pour mes amis le week-end.
hobbies and weekends.en: I like cooking for my friends at the weekend.
hobbies and weekends.pt: Eu gosto de cozinhar para os meus amigos no fim de semana.

hobbies and weekends.text: Je vais courir au parc demain matin.
hobbies and weekends.en: I'm going running in the park tomorrow morning.
hobbies and weekends.pt: Vou correr no parque amanhã de manhã.

hobbies and weekends.text: Mes enfants font de la natation le mercredi.
hobbies and weekends.en: My children go swimming on Wednesdays.
hobbies and weekends.pt: Meus filhos fazem natação às quartas.

hobbies and weekends.text: On a visité une exposition de photos.
hobbies and weekends.en: We visited a photography exhibition.
hobbies and weekends.pt: A gente visitou uma exposição de fotos.

hobbies and weekends.text: Tu veux jouer aux cartes avec nous ?
hobbies and weekends.en: Do you want to play cards with us?
hobbies and weekends.pt: Você quer jogar cartas com a gente?

hobbies and weekends.text: Mon passe-temps préféré, c'est le jardinage.
hobbies and weekends.en: My favourite hobby is gardening.
hobbies and weekends.pt: Meu passatempo preferido é a jardinagem.

hobbies and weekends.text: Ce week-end, je vais me reposer à la maison.
hobbies and weekends.en: This weekend, I'm going to rest at home.
hobbies and weekends.pt: Neste fim de semana, vou descansar em casa.

hobbies and weekends.text: Elle peint des paysages pendant son temps libre.
hobbies and weekends.en: She paints landscapes in her free time.
hobbies and weekends.pt: Ela pinta paisagens no tempo livre.

hobbies and weekends.text: On a fait du vélo le long du canal.
hobbies and weekends.en: We went cycling along the canal.
hobbies and weekends.pt: A gente andou de bicicleta ao longo do canal.

hobbies and weekends.text: Je regarde des séries le soir avant de dormir.
hobbies and weekends.en: I watch series in the evening before going to sleep.
hobbies and weekends.pt: Eu assisto séries à noite antes de dormir.

hobbies and weekends.text: Nous allons faire un pique-nique au bord du lac.
hobbies and weekends.en: We're going to have a picnic by the lake.
hobbies and weekends.pt: Nós vamos fazer um piquenique à beira do lago.

hobbies and weekends.text: Hugo joue au foot dans un club depuis l'enfance.
hobbies and weekends.en: Hugo has played football in a club since childhood.
hobbies and weekends.pt: O Hugo joga futebol num clube desde criança.

hobbies and weekends.text: J'ai appris à faire du pain maison.
hobbies and weekends.en: I learned to make homemade bread.
hobbies and weekends.pt: Eu aprendi a fazer pão caseiro.

hobbies and weekends.text: Tu aimes jouer aux jeux vidéo le soir ?
hobbies and weekends.en: Do you like playing video games in the evening?
hobbies and weekends.pt: Você gosta de jogar videogame à noite?

hobbies and weekends.text: Samedi, on va au marché puis au café.
hobbies and weekends.en: On Saturday, we're going to the market and then to the café.
hobbies and weekends.pt: No sábado, a gente vai à feira e depois ao café.

hobbies and weekends.text: Elle chante dans une chorale depuis trois ans.
hobbies and weekends.en: She has been singing in a choir for three years.
hobbies and weekends.pt: Ela canta num coral há três anos.

hobbies and weekends.text: Je fais des photos quand je me promène.
hobbies and weekends.en: I take photos when I go for walks.
hobbies and weekends.pt: Eu tiro fotos quando saio para passear.

hobbies and weekends.text: Ils sont partis camper à la campagne.
hobbies and weekends.en: They went camping in the countryside.
hobbies and weekends.pt: Eles foram acampar no interior.

hobbies and weekends.text: Le club de lecture se réunit le jeudi soir.
hobbies and weekends.en: The book club meets on Thursday evenings.
hobbies and weekends.pt: O clube do livro se reúne às quintas à noite.

hobbies and weekends.text: On a joué à des jeux de société toute la soirée.
hobbies and weekends.en: We played board games all evening.
hobbies and weekends.pt: A gente jogou jogos de tabuleiro a noite toda.

hobbies and weekends.text: Je vais m'inscrire à un cours de danse.
hobbies and weekends.en: I'm going to sign up for a dance class.
hobbies and weekends.pt: Vou me inscrever numa aula de dança.

hobbies and weekends.text: Tu as passé un bon week-end ?
hobbies and weekends.en: Did you have a good weekend?
hobbies and weekends.pt: Você teve um bom fim de semana?

hobbies and weekends.text: Le dimanche matin, je fais la grasse matinée.
hobbies and weekends.en: On Sunday mornings, I have a lie-in.
hobbies and weekends.pt: No domingo de manhã, eu durmo até tarde.

hobbies and weekends.text: Mon père va à la pêche avec ses amis.
hobbies and weekends.en: My father goes fishing with his friends.
hobbies and weekends.pt: Meu pai vai pescar com os amigos.

hobbies and weekends.text: Nous avons fait une randonnée de quinze kilomètres.
hobbies and weekends.en: We did a fifteen-kilometre hike.
hobbies and weekends.pt: Nós fizemos uma trilha de quinze quilômetros.

hobbies and weekends.text: J'écoute de la musique en faisant le ménage.
hobbies and weekends.en: I listen to music while doing the housework.
hobbies and weekends.pt: Eu escuto música enquanto faço faxina.

hobbies and weekends.text: Emma fait de l'escalade dans une salle en ville.
hobbies and weekends.en: Emma goes climbing at a gym in town.
hobbies and weekends.pt: A Emma faz escalada numa academia na cidade.

hobbies and weekends.text: On va au théâtre avec des collègues samedi.
hobbies and weekends.en: We're going to the theatre with some colleagues on Saturday.
hobbies and weekends.pt: A gente vai ao teatro com uns colegas no sábado.

hobbies and weekends.text: J'ai tricoté une écharpe pour ma sœur.
hobbies and weekends.en: I knitted a scarf for my sister.
hobbies and weekends.pt: Eu tricotei um cachecol para a minha irmã.

hobbies and weekends.text: Le week-end prochain, on part à la mer.
hobbies and weekends.en: Next weekend, we're off to the seaside.
hobbies and weekends.pt: No próximo fim de semana, a gente vai para o litoral.

hobbies and weekends.text: Le musée est gratuit le premier dimanche du mois.
hobbies and weekends.en: The museum is free on the first Sunday of the month.
hobbies and weekends.pt: O museu é gratuito no primeiro domingo do mês.

home and daily routine.text: Je me lève à sept heures tous les jours.
home and daily routine.en: I get up at seven every day.
home and daily routine.pt: Eu me levanto às sete todos os dias.

home and daily routine.text: Le matin, je prends une douche rapide.
home and daily routine.en: In the morning, I take a quick shower.
home and daily routine.pt: De manhã, eu tomo um banho rápido.

home and daily routine.text: Nous prenons le petit-déjeuner dans la cuisine.
home and daily routine.en: We have breakfast in the kitchen.
home and daily routine.pt: Nós tomamos café da manhã na cozinha.

home and daily routine.text: Il se brosse les dents après chaque repas.
home and daily routine.en: He brushes his teeth after every meal.
home and daily routine.pt: Ele escova os dentes depois de cada refeição.

home and daily routine.text: Je vais faire la vaisselle après le dîner.
home and daily routine.en: I'm going to do the dishes after dinner.
home and daily routine.pt: Vou lavar a louça depois do jantar.

home and daily routine.text: Tu as sorti les poubelles ce matin ?
home and daily routine.en: Did you take the bins out this morning?
home and daily routine.pt: Você levou o lixo para fora hoje de manhã?

home and daily routine.text: Mon appartement a deux chambres et un balcon.
home and daily routine.en: My flat has two bedrooms and a balcony.
home and daily routine.pt: Meu apartamento tem dois quartos e uma varanda.

home and daily routine.text: Le soir, on regarde les informations à la télé.
home and daily routine.en: In the evening, we watch the news on TV.
home and daily routine.pt: À noite, a gente assiste ao jornal na TV.

home and daily routine.text: J'ai fait le ménage dans tout l'appartement.
home and daily routine.en: I cleaned the whole flat.
home and daily routine.pt: Eu fiz faxina no apartamento inteiro.

home and daily routine.text: Elle se couche vers onze heures du soir.
home and daily routine.en: She goes to bed around eleven at night.
home and daily routine.pt: Ela vai dormir por volta das onze da noite.

home and daily routine.text: Qui va passer l'aspirateur aujourd'hui ?
home and daily routine.en: Who's going to vacuum today?
home and daily routine.pt: Quem vai passar o aspirador hoje?

home and daily routine.text: Je prends le bus pour aller au travail.
home and daily routine.en: I take the bus to go to work.
home and daily routine.pt: Eu pego o ônibus para ir ao trabalho.

home and daily routine.text: Les enfants rentrent de l'école à seize heures trente.
home and daily routine.en: The children come home from school at 4:30.
home and daily routine.pt: As crianças voltam da escola às dezesseis e trinta.

home and daily routine.text: Nous avons repeint la cuisine en jaune.
home and daily routine.en: We repainted the kitchen yellow.
home and daily routine.pt: Nós pintamos a cozinha de amarelo.

home and daily routine.text: La machine à laver est en panne depuis hier.
home and daily routine.en: The washing machine has been broken since yesterday.
home and daily routine.pt: A máquina de lavar está quebrada desde ontem.

home and daily routine.text: Je prépare le déjeuner pour toute la famille.
home and daily routine.en: I'm making lunch for the whole family.
home and daily routine.pt: Estou preparando o almoço para a família toda.

home and daily routine.text: Tu peux mettre la table, s'il te plaît ?
home and daily routine.en: Can you set the table, please?
home and daily routine.pt: Você pode pôr a mesa, por favor?

home and daily routine.text: Il a oublié d'éteindre la lumière dans le salon.
home and daily routine.en: He forgot to turn off the light in the living room.
home and daily routine.pt: Ele esqueceu de apagar a luz da sala.

home and daily routine.text: Le dimanche, je repasse mes chemises.
home and daily routine.en: On Sundays, I iron my shirts.
home and daily routine.pt: Aos domingos, eu passo as minhas camisas.

home and daily routine.text: On va acheter un nouveau lit pour la chambre.
home and daily routine.en: We're going to buy a new bed for the bedroom.
home and daily routine.pt: A gente vai comprar uma cama nova para o quarto.

home and daily routine.text: Ma chambre donne sur une petite cour.
home and daily routine.en: My bedroom looks onto a small courtyard.
home and daily routine.pt: Meu quarto dá para um pequeno pátio.

home and daily routine.text: Je m'habille vite parce que je suis en retard.
home and daily routine.en: I get dressed quickly because I'm late.
home and daily routine.pt: Eu me visto rápido porque estou atrasado.

home and daily routine.text: Le chat dort toujours sur le canapé.
home and daily routine.en: The cat always sleeps on the sofa.
home and daily routine.pt: O gato sempre dorme no sofá.

home and daily routine.text: Après le travail, je fais une petite sieste.
home and daily routine.en: After work, I take a short nap.
home and daily routine.pt: Depois do trabalho, eu tiro um cochilo.

home and daily routine.text: Nous habitons au quatrième étage sans ascenseur.
home and daily routine.en: We live on the fourth floor with no lift.
home and daily routine.pt: Nós moramos no quarto andar sem elevador.

home and daily routine.text: J'arrose les plantes deux fois par semaine.
home and daily routine.en: I water the plants twice a week.
home and daily routine.pt: Eu rego as plantas duas vezes por semana.

home and daily routine.text: Ce matin, je n'ai pas entendu mon réveil.
home and daily routine.en: This morning, I didn't hear my alarm clock.
home and daily routine.pt: Hoje de manhã, eu não ouvi o despertador.

home and daily routine.text: Léo range sa chambre tous les samedis.
home and daily routine.en: Léo tidies his room every Saturday.
home and daily routine.pt: O Léo arruma o quarto todo sábado.

home and daily routine.text: La salle de bains est à côté de la chambre.
home and daily routine.en: The bathroom is next to the bedroom.
home and daily routine.pt: O banheiro fica ao lado do quarto.

home and daily routine.text: Je vais changer les draps aujourd'hui.
home and daily routine.en: I'm going to change the sheets today.
home and daily routine.pt: Vou trocar os lençóis hoje.

home and daily routine.text: Il faut fermer la porte à clé en sortant.
home and daily routine.en: You have to lock the door when you go out.
home and daily routine.pt: É preciso trancar a porta ao sair.

home and daily routine.text: On a déménagé dans une maison avec jardin.
home and daily routine.en: We moved into a house with a garden.
home and daily routine.pt: A gente se mudou para uma casa com jardim.

home and daily routine.text: Je bois un café avant de partir au travail.
home and daily routine.en: I drink a coffee before leaving for work.
home and daily routine.pt: Eu tomo um café antes de sair para o trabalho.

home and daily routine.text: Le frigo est presque vide, il faut faire les courses.
home and daily routine.en: The fridge is almost empty, we need to go shopping.
home and daily routine.pt: A geladeira está quase vazia, precisamos fazer compras.

home and daily routine.text: Tu as fermé la fenêtre de la cuisine ?
home and daily routine.en: Did you close the kitchen window?
home and daily routine.pt: Você fechou a janela da cozinha?

home and daily routine.text: Elle étend le linge sur le balcon.
home and daily routine.en: She hangs the laundry out on the balcony.
home and daily routine.pt: Ela estende a roupa na varanda.

home and daily routine.text: Je rentre à la maison vers dix-huit heures.
home and daily routine.en: I get home around six in the evening.
home and daily routine.pt: Eu volto para casa por volta das dezoito horas.

home and daily routine.text: Mon mari fait la cuisine et moi, la vaisselle.
home and daily routine.en: My husband does the cooking and I do the dishes.
home and daily routine.pt: Meu marido cozinha e eu lavo a louça.

home and daily routine.text: Nous allons installer une étagère dans le couloir.
home and daily routine.en: We're going to put up a shelf in the hallway.
home and daily routine.pt: Nós vamos instalar uma prateleira no corredor.

home and daily routine.text: Le chauffage ne marche pas, il fait froid !
home and daily routine.en: The heating isn't working, it's cold!
home and daily routine.pt: O aquecedor não está funcionando, está frio!

feelings and opinions.text: Je suis vraiment content de te voir !
feelings and opinions.en: I'm really happy to see you!
feelings and opinions.pt: Estou muito feliz de te ver!

feelings and opinions.text: À mon avis, ce film est trop long.
feelings and opinions.en: In my opinion, this film is too long.
feelings and opinions.pt: Na minha opinião, este filme é longo demais.

feelings and opinions.text: Elle est triste parce que son chat est malade.
feelings and opinions.en: She's sad because her cat is ill.
feelings and opinions.pt: Ela está triste porque o gato dela está doente.

feelings and opinions.text: Tu as l'air fatigué, tout va bien ?
feelings and opinions.en: You look tired, is everything OK?
feelings and opinions.pt: Você parece cansado, está tudo bem?

feelings and opinions.text: J'ai peur des araignées depuis toujours.
feelings and opinions.en: I've always been scared of spiders.
feelings and opinions.pt: Eu sempre tive medo de aranhas.

feelings and opinions.text: Nous sommes très fiers de notre fils.
feelings and opinions.en: We're very proud of our son.
feelings and opinions.pt: Nós temos muito orgulho do nosso filho.

feelings and opinions.text: Ça m'énerve quand le bus est en retard.
feelings and opinions.en: It annoys me when the bus is late.
feelings and opinions.pt: Me irrita quando o ônibus atrasa.

feelings and opinions.text: Qu'est-ce que tu penses de ce restaurant ?
feelings and opinions.en: What do you think of this restaurant?
feelings and opinions.pt: O que você acha deste restaurante?

feelings and opinions.text: Je suis d'accord avec toi sur ce point.
feelings and opinions.en: I agree with you on that point.
feelings and opinions.pt: Concordo com você nesse ponto.

feelings and opinions.text: Il est stressé à cause de ses examens.
feelings and opinions.en: He's stressed because of his exams.
feelings and opinions.pt: Ele está estressado por causa das provas.

feelings and opinions.text: J'ai été très surpris par la nouvelle.
feelings and opinions.en: I was very surprised by the news.
feelings and opinions.pt: Eu fiquei muito surpreso com a notícia.

feelings and opinions.text: Je trouve que ce livre est passionnant.
feelings and opinions.en: I find this book fascinating.
feelings and opinions.pt: Eu acho este livro fascinante.

feelings and opinions.text: Elle s'ennuie un peu à la campagne.
feelings and opinions.en: She's a bit bored in the countryside.
feelings and opinions.pt: Ela fica um pouco entediada no interior.

feelings and opinions.text: Je ne suis pas sûr, je vais réfléchir.
feelings and opinions.en: I'm not sure, I'm going to think about it.
feelings and opinions.pt: Não tenho certeza, vou pensar.

feelings and opinions.text: On est vraiment heureux dans notre nouvelle maison.
feelings and opinions.en: We're really happy in our new house.
feelings and opinions.pt: A gente está muito feliz na nossa casa nova.

feelings and opinions.text: Tu as raison, c'est beaucoup trop cher.
feelings and opinions.en: You're right, it's far too expensive.
feelings and opinions.pt: Você tem razão, está caro demais.

feelings and opinions.text: Ça me fait plaisir de vous aider.
feelings and opinions.en: I'm happy to help you.
feelings and opinions.pt: É um prazer ajudar vocês.

feelings and opinions.text: Je préfère la mer à la montagne.
feelings and opinions.en: I prefer the sea to the mountains.
feelings and opinions.pt: Eu prefiro o mar à montanha.

feelings and opinions.text: Franchement, je n'aime pas du tout cette chanson.
feelings and opinions.en: Honestly, I don't like this song at all.
feelings and opinions.pt: Sinceramente, eu não gosto nada dessa música.

feelings and opinions.text: Elle a été déçue par le concert.
feelings and opinions.en: She was disappointed by the concert.
feelings and opinions.pt: Ela ficou decepcionada com o show.

feelings and opinions.text: Je suis inquiet, Paul n'est pas encore rentré.
feelings and opinions.en: I'm worried, Paul isn't home yet.
feelings and opinions.pt: Estou preocupado, o Paul ainda não voltou.

feelings and opinions.text: Pour moi, la famille, c'est le plus important.
feelings and opinions.en: For me, family is the most important thing.
feelings and opinions.pt: Para mim, a família é o mais importante.

feelings and opinions.text: Vous êtes nerveux avant l'examen ?
feelings and opinions.en: Are you nervous before the exam?
feelings and opinions.pt: Você está nervoso antes da prova?

feelings and opinions.text: J'adore ce quartier, il est très vivant.
feelings and opinions.en: I love this neighbourhood, it's very lively.
feelings and opinions.pt: Eu adoro este bairro, ele é muito animado.

feelings and opinions.text: Il a l'air de bonne humeur ce matin.
feelings and opinions.en: He seems to be in a good mood this morning.
feelings and opinions.pt: Ele parece estar de bom humor hoje de manhã.

feelings and opinions.text: Je ne suis pas d'accord avec cette décision.
feelings and opinions.en: I don't agree with this decision.
feelings and opinions.pt: Eu não concordo com essa decisão.

feelings and opinions.text: Les enfants sont tout excités avant Noël.
feelings and opinions.en: The children are all excited before Christmas.
feelings and opinions.pt: As crianças ficam todas animadas antes do Natal.

feelings and opinions.text: Ça ne me dérange pas d'attendre un peu.
feelings and opinions.en: I don't mind waiting a bit.
feelings and opinions.pt: Não me incomoda esperar um pouco.

feelings and opinions.text: J'ai honte, j'ai oublié son anniversaire.
feelings and opinions.en: I'm ashamed, I forgot her birthday.
feelings and opinions.pt: Estou com vergonha, esqueci o aniversário dela.

feelings and opinions.text: Je trouve cette ville un peu trop bruyante.
feelings and opinions.en: I find this city a bit too noisy.
feelings and opinions.pt: Eu acho esta cidade um pouco barulhenta demais.

feelings and opinions.text: Tu as aimé le spectacle hier soir ?
feelings and opinions.en: Did you enjoy the show last night?
feelings and opinions.pt: Você gostou do espetáculo ontem à noite?

feelings and opinions.text: Elle est amoureuse de son collègue.
feelings and opinions.en: She's in love with her colleague.
feelings and opinions.pt: Ela está apaixonada pelo colega de trabalho.

feelings and opinions.text: Je suis soulagé, tout s'est bien passé.
feelings and opinions.en: I'm relieved, everything went well.
feelings and opinions.pt: Estou aliviado, deu tudo certo.

feelings and opinions.text: À ton avis, quel cadeau va lui faire plaisir ?
feelings and opinions.en: In your opinion, which present will make him happy?
feelings and opinions.pt: Na sua opinião, que presente vai agradar a ele?

feelings and opinions.text: Nous sommes un peu tristes de partir.
feelings and opinions.en: We're a little sad to leave.
feelings and opinions.pt: Nós estamos um pouco tristes de ir embora.

feelings and opinions.text: C'est génial, j'ai réussi mon examen !
feelings and opinions.en: That's great, I passed my exam!
feelings and opinions.pt: Que demais, passei na prova!

feelings and opinions.text: Je déteste attendre dans les files d'attente.
feelings and opinions.en: I hate waiting in queues.
feelings and opinions.pt: Eu odeio esperar em filas.

feelings and opinions.text: Il me semble que tu as changé de coiffure.
feelings and opinions.en: It seems to me that you've changed your hairstyle.
feelings and opinions.pt: Parece que você mudou o corte de cabelo.

small talk with a neighbour.text: Bonjour, madame Leroy, vous allez bien ?
small talk with a neighbour.en: Hello, Mrs Leroy, how are you?
small talk with a neighbour.pt: Bom dia, dona Leroy, tudo bem com a senhora?

small talk with a neighbour.text: Il fait beau aujourd'hui, n'est-ce pas ?
small talk with a neighbour.en: It's a nice day today, isn't it?
small talk with a neighbour.pt: O dia está bonito hoje, não está?

small talk with a neighbour.text: Vous avez passé de bonnes vacances ?
small talk with a neighbour.en: Did you have a good holiday?
small talk with a neighbour.pt: Você teve boas férias?

small talk with a neighbour.text: Votre chien est très mignon, il s'appelle comment ?
small talk with a neighbour.en: Your dog is very cute, what's his name?
small talk with a neighbour.pt: Seu cachorro é muito fofo, como ele se chama?

small talk with a neighbour.text: Je viens d'emménager au deuxième étage.
small talk with a neighbour.en: I've just moved in on the second floor.
small talk with a neighbour.pt: Acabei de me mudar para o segundo andar.

small talk with a neighbour.text: Les nouveaux voisins sont arrivés samedi.
