small talk with a neighbour.en: The new neighbours arrived on Saturday.
small talk with a neighbour.pt: Os vizinhos novos chegaram no sábado.

small talk with a neighbour.text: Vous pouvez arroser mes plantes pendant mon absence ?
small talk with a neighbour.en: Could you water my plants while I'm away?
small talk with a neighbour.pt: Você pode regar minhas plantas enquanto eu estiver fora?

small talk with a neighbour.text: Le facteur a laissé un colis pour vous.
small talk with a neighbour.en: The postman left a parcel for you.
small talk with a neighbour.pt: O carteiro deixou um pacote para você.

small talk with a neighbour.text: Comme vos enfants ont grandi, c'est incroyable !
small talk with a neighbour.en: How your children have grown, it's incredible!
small talk with a neighbour.pt: Como os seus filhos cresceram, é incrível!

small talk with a neighbour.text: On organise une fête des voisins en juin.
small talk with a neighbour.en: We're organising a neighbourhood party in June.
small talk with a neighbour.pt: A gente está organizando uma festa dos vizinhos em junho.

small talk with a neighbour.text: Désolé pour le bruit d'hier soir, monsieur Petit.
small talk with a neighbour.en: Sorry about the noise last night, Mr Petit.
small talk with a neighbour.pt: Desculpe pelo barulho de ontem à noite, seu Petit.

small talk with a neighbour.text: L'ascenseur est encore en panne ce matin.
small talk with a neighbour.en: The lift is broken again this morning.
small talk with a neighbour.pt: O elevador está quebrado de novo hoje de manhã.

small talk with a neighbour.text: Vous avez entendu l'orage cette nuit ?
small talk with a neighbour.en: Did you hear the storm last night?
small talk with a neighbour.pt: Você ouviu a tempestade esta noite?

small talk with a neighbour.text: Je vais au marché, vous avez besoin de quelque chose ?
small talk with a neighbour.en: I'm going to the market, do you need anything?
small talk with a neighbour.pt: Vou à feira, você precisa de alguma coisa?

small talk with a neighbour.text: Votre jardin est magnifique avec toutes ces roses.
small talk with a neighbour.en: Your garden is beautiful with all those roses.
small talk with a neighbour.pt: Seu jardim está lindo com todas essas rosas.

small talk with a neighbour.text: Bonne journée, et à ce soir peut-être !
small talk with a neighbour.en: Have a nice day, and maybe see you tonight!
small talk with a neighbour.pt: Tenha um bom dia, e até a noite, talvez!

small talk with a neighbour.text: Mon fils peut vous aider à porter vos sacs.
small talk with a neighbour.en: My son can help you carry your bags.
small talk with a neighbour.pt: Meu filho pode ajudar você a carregar as sacolas.

small talk with a neighbour.text: La boulangerie du coin est fermée en août.
small talk with a neighbour.en: The bakery on the corner is closed in August.
small talk with a neighbour.pt: A padaria da esquina fica fechada em agosto.

small talk with a neighbour.text: Les Bernard ont repeint leurs volets en bleu.
small talk with a neighbour.en: The Bernards painted their shutters blue.
small talk with a neighbour.pt: Os Bernard pintaram as venezianas de azul.

small talk with a neighbour.text: Vous partez en week-end avec la famille ?
small talk with a neighbour.en: Are you going away for the weekend with the family?
small talk with a neighbour.pt: Vocês vão viajar no fim de semana com a família?

small talk with a neighbour.text: Il y a une réunion de copropriété jeudi.
small talk with a neighbour.en: There's a residents' meeting on Thursday.
small talk with a neighbour.pt: Tem uma reunião de condomínio na quinta.

small talk with a neighbour.text: Merci beaucoup pour les gâteaux, ils sont délicieux !
small talk with a neighbour.en: Thank you so much for the cakes, they're delicious!
small talk with a neighbour.pt: Muito obrigado pelos bolos, estão deliciosos!

small talk with a neighbour.text: Votre fille joue très bien du piano.
small talk with a neighbour.en: Your daughter plays the piano very well.
small talk with a neighbour.pt: Sua filha toca piano muito bem.

small talk with a neighbour.text: Vous avez vu, ils construisent un immeuble en face.
small talk with a neighbour.en: Have you seen, they're building a block of flats opposite.
small talk with a neighbour.pt: Você viu, estão construindo um prédio em frente.

small talk with a neighbour.text: Je peux vous emprunter une échelle, s'il vous plaît ?
small talk with a neighbour.en: Could I borrow a ladder from you, please?
small talk with a neighbour.pt: Posso pegar uma escada emprestada, por favor?

small talk with a neighbour.text: Comment va votre mari, il est rentré de l'hôpital ?
small talk with a neighbour.en: How is your husband, is he back from hospital?
small talk with a neighbour.pt: Como está o seu marido, ele já voltou do hospital?

small talk with a neighbour.text: Le quartier est calme le dimanche matin.
small talk with a neighbour.en: The neighbourhood is quiet on Sunday mornings.
small talk with a neighbour.pt: O bairro fica tranquilo no domingo de manhã.

small talk with a neighbour.text: Je vous présente ma femme, Nathalie.
small talk with a neighbour.en: Let me introduce my wife, Nathalie.
small talk with a neighbour.pt: Quero te apresentar minha esposa, Nathalie.

small talk with a neighbour.text: Vous avez trouvé une place pour vous garer ?
small talk with a neighbour.en: Did you find a parking space?
small talk with a neighbour.pt: Você achou uma vaga para estacionar?

small talk with a neighbour.text: Bonsoir, vous rentrez tard du travail aujourd'hui.
small talk with a neighbour.en: Good evening, you're home late from work today.
small talk with a neighbour.pt: Boa noite, você está voltando tarde do trabalho hoje.

small talk with a neighbour.text: Votre chat est encore venu dans mon jardin.
small talk with a neighbour.en: Your cat came into my garden again.
small talk with a neighbour.pt: Seu gato veio de novo no meu jardim.

small talk with a neighbour.text: Vous venez boire un café chez nous dimanche ?
small talk with a neighbour.en: Would you like to come for coffee at our place on Sunday?
small talk with a neighbour.pt: Vocês querem vir tomar um café em casa no domingo?

small talk with a neighbour.text: Mon voisin m'a aidé à monter le nouveau meuble.
small talk with a neighbour.en: My neighbour helped me put together the new furniture.
small talk with a neighbour.pt: Meu vizinho me ajudou a montar o móvel novo.

small talk with a neighbour.text: Le gardien a nettoyé l'escalier ce matin.
small talk with a neighbour.en: The caretaker cleaned the stairs this morning.
small talk with a neighbour.pt: O zelador limpou a escada hoje de manhã.

small talk with a neighbour.text: Vous connaissez un bon plombier dans le quartier ?
small talk with a neighbour.en: Do you know a good plumber in the neighbourhood?
small talk with a neighbour.pt: Você conhece um bom encanador no bairro?

small talk with a neighbour.text: Les travaux dans la rue vont durer un mois.
small talk with a neighbour.en: The roadworks in the street are going to last a month.
small talk with a neighbour.pt: As obras na rua vão durar um mês.

small talk with a neighbour.text: Je vous rends votre perceuse, merci encore !
small talk with a neighbour.en: Here's your drill back, thanks again!
small talk with a neighbour.pt: Estou devolvendo a sua furadeira, obrigado de novo!

small talk with a neighbour.text: Ça fait plaisir de vous revoir, madame Girard.
small talk with a neighbour.en: It's nice to see you again, Mrs Girard.
small talk with a neighbour.pt: Que bom ver a senhora de novo, dona Girard.

small talk with a neighbour.text: Passez une bonne soirée, et à bientôt !
small talk with a neighbour.en: Have a nice evening, and see you soon!
small talk with a neighbour.pt: Tenha uma boa noite, e até logo!

phone calls and appointments.text: Allô, bonjour, je voudrais parler à madame Durand.
phone calls and appointments.en: Hello, I'd like to speak to Mrs Durand.
phone calls and appointments.pt: Alô, bom dia, eu queria falar com a senhora Durand.

phone calls and appointments.text: Ne quittez pas, je vous la passe.
phone calls and appointments.en: Hold on, I'll put you through to her.
phone calls and appointments.pt: Não desligue, vou passar para ela.

phone calls and appointments.text: Je vous appelle pour prendre un rendez-vous.
phone calls and appointments.en: I'm calling to make an appointment.
phone calls and appointments.pt: Estou ligando para marcar um horário.

phone calls and appointments.text: Vous êtes disponible mardi à quatorze heures ?
phone calls and appointments.en: Are you available on Tuesday at 2 p.m.?
phone calls and appointments.pt: Você está disponível na terça às catorze horas?

phone calls and appointments.text: Désolé, je n'ai pas entendu mon téléphone.
phone calls and appointments.en: Sorry, I didn't hear my phone.
phone calls and appointments.pt: Desculpe, eu não ouvi o meu telefone.

phone calls and appointments.text: Je peux laisser un message, s'il vous plaît ?
phone calls and appointments.en: Can I leave a message, please?
phone calls and appointments.pt: Posso deixar um recado, por favor?

phone calls and appointments.text: Je vais rappeler plus tard dans l'après-midi.
phone calls and appointments.en: I'll call back later in the afternoon.
phone calls and appointments.pt: Vou ligar de novo mais tarde, à tarde.

phone calls and appointments.text: Mon rendez-vous chez le coiffeur est à dix heures.
phone calls and appointments.en: My hairdresser's appointment is at ten.
phone calls and appointments.pt: Meu horário no cabeleireiro é às dez.

phone calls and appointments.text: La ligne est mauvaise, je ne vous entends pas.
phone calls and appointments.en: The line is bad, I can't hear you.
phone calls and appointments.pt: A ligação está ruim, não estou ouvindo você.

phone calls and appointments.text: Qui est à l'appareil, s'il vous plaît ?
phone calls and appointments.en: Who's speaking, please?
phone calls and appointments.pt: Quem está falando, por favor?

phone calls and appointments.text: J'ai annulé mon rendez-vous de jeudi.
phone calls and appointments.en: I cancelled my Thursday appointment.
phone calls and appointments.pt: Eu cancelei o meu compromisso de quinta.

phone calls and appointments.text: Vous pouvez répéter votre numéro, s'il vous plaît ?
phone calls and appointments.en: Could you repeat your number, please?
phone calls and appointments.pt: Você pode repetir o seu número, por favor?

phone calls and appointments.text: Elle a appelé trois fois, mais personne n'a répondu.
phone calls and appointments.en: She called three times, but nobody answered.
phone calls and appointments.pt: Ela ligou três vezes, mas ninguém atendeu.

phone calls and appointments.text: On peut se voir vendredi vers midi ?
phone calls and appointments.en: Can we meet on Friday around noon?
phone calls and appointments.pt: A gente pode se ver na sexta por volta do meio-dia?

phone calls and appointments.text: Je voudrais changer l'heure de mon rendez-vous.
phone calls and appointments.en: I'd like to change the time of my appointment.
phone calls and appointments.pt: Eu queria mudar o horário da minha consulta.

phone calls and appointments.text: Il m'a envoyé un SMS pour confirmer.
phone calls and appointments.en: He sent me a text to confirm.
phone calls and appointments.pt: Ele me mandou uma mensagem para confirmar.

phone calls and appointments.text: Vous avez fait un mauvais numéro, monsieur.
phone calls and appointments.en: You've dialled the wrong number, sir.
phone calls and appointments.pt: O senhor ligou para o número errado.

phone calls and appointments.text: Le secrétariat est ouvert de neuf heures à midi.
phone calls and appointments.en: The office is open from nine to noon.
phone calls and appointments.pt: A secretaria funciona das nove ao meio-dia.

phone calls and appointments.text: Je vais t'appeler ce soir après le dîner.
phone calls and appointments.en: I'll call you tonight after dinner.
phone calls and appointments.pt: Vou te ligar hoje à noite depois do jantar.

phone calls and appointments.text: Vous pouvez me rappeler sur mon portable ?
phone calls and appointments.en: Could you call me back on my mobile?
phone calls and appointments.pt: Você pode me ligar de volta no celular?

phone calls and appointments.text: Il est en ligne, vous pouvez patienter ?
phone calls and appointments.en: He's on another call, can you hold?
phone calls and appointments.pt: Ele está em outra ligação, você pode aguardar?

phone calls and appointments.text: J'ai un rendez-vous chez le dentiste lundi matin.
phone calls and appointments.en: I have a dentist's appointment on Monday morning.
phone calls and appointments.pt: Tenho consulta no dentista na segunda de manhã.

phone calls and appointments.text: Le prochain créneau libre est mercredi prochain.
phone calls and appointments.en: The next available slot is next Wednesday.
phone calls and appointments.pt: O próximo horário livre é na quarta que vem.

phone calls and appointments.text: Tu as eu mon message vocal ?
phone calls and appointments.en: Did you get my voicemail?
phone calls and appointments.pt: Você recebeu o meu áudio na caixa postal?

phone calls and appointments.text: Je suis en retard, j'arrive dans dix minutes.
phone calls and appointments.en: I'm running late, I'll be there in ten minutes.
phone calls and appointments.pt: Estou atrasado, chego em dez minutos.

phone calls and appointments.text: On a fixé le rendez-vous à quinze heures trente.
phone calls and appointments.en: We set the appointment for 3:30 p.m.
phone calls and appointments.pt: A gente marcou o encontro para as quinze e trinta.

phone calls and appointments.text: Laissez votre nom et votre numéro après le bip.
phone calls and appointments.en: Leave your name and number after the beep.
phone calls and appointments.pt: Deixe seu nome e seu número depois do sinal.

phone calls and appointments.text: Elle ne répond pas, je lui envoie un message.
phone calls and appointments.en: She isn't answering, I'll send her a message.
phone calls and appointments.pt: Ela não está atendendo, vou mandar uma mensagem para ela.

phone calls and appointments.text: Est-ce que monsieur Lambert est au bureau aujourd'hui ?
phone calls and appointments.en: Is Mr Lambert in the office today?
phone calls and appointments.pt: O senhor Lambert está no escritório hoje?

phone calls and appointments.text: Je vous confirme le rendez-vous par mail.
phone calls and appointments.en: I'll confirm the appointment by email.
phone calls and appointments.pt: Vou confirmar o horário com você por e-mail.

phone calls and appointments.text: Vous avez un rendez-vous plus tôt dans la semaine ?
phone calls and appointments.en: Do you have an earlier appointment in the week?
phone calls and appointments.pt: Você tem um horário mais cedo na semana?

phone calls and appointments.text: Désolée, je dois raccrocher, j'ai un autre appel.
phone calls and appointments.en: Sorry, I have to hang up, I have another call.
phone calls and appointments.pt: Desculpe, preciso desligar, tenho outra ligação.

phone calls and appointments.text: Mon portable a sonné pendant la réunion.
phone calls and appointments.en: My mobile rang during the meeting.
phone calls and appointments.pt: Meu celular tocou durante a reunião.

phone calls and appointments.text: Le garagiste va me rappeler demain matin.
phone calls and appointments.en: The mechanic is going to call me back tomorrow morning.
phone calls and appointments.pt: O mecânico vai me retornar amanhã de manhã.

phone calls and appointments.text: Je n'ai pas de réseau dans le métro.
phone calls and appointments.en: I don't have any signal in the metro.
phone calls and appointments.pt: Eu não tenho sinal no metrô.

phone calls and appointments.text: Le rendez-vous est au nom de Camille Roux.
phone calls and appointments.en: The appointment is under the name Camille Roux.
phone calls and appointments.pt: O horário está no nome de Camille Roux.

phone calls and appointments.text: Vous pouvez me donner votre adresse mail ?
phone calls and appointments.en: Could you give me your email address?
phone calls and appointments.pt: Você pode me passar o seu e-mail?

phone calls and appointments.text: À quelle heure est notre rendez-vous demain ?
phone calls and appointments.en: What time is our appointment tomorrow?
phone calls and appointments.pt: A que horas é o nosso compromisso amanhã?
